sloka: स तान् बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव ।प्रासादं शैलसङ्कासमुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा ।। ६.४१.८५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tān bāhudvaye saktānādāya patagāniva ।prāsādaṁ śailasaṅkāsamutpapātāṅgadastadā ।। 6.41.85 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, having heard the words of Ravana, the four Rakshasas seized Angada blazing in brilliance like fire.
